name: Riesz Haitokuki
source:
Defeated in battle against the Archdemon, Reese finds herself imprisoned. What awaits her there is... a forbidden incestuous union with Elliot, who has made a pact with the Black Prince and become a vengeful abuser. The repeated incestuous acts between siblings... what will be the outcome?

[Translated from Official Website]
translation:
里斯在与大恶魔的战斗中失败，发现自己被囚禁。在那里等待着她的是……与艾略特​​的禁止乱伦结合，艾略特与黑王子签订了协议，成为了一个复仇心重的施虐者。兄妹间屡屡乱伦……结果会如何？
